moments.title: Halloween countdown begins
moments.blurb: With Halloween just over two weeks away, events across the UK are ramping up, offering everything from family-friendly frights to full-on scare experiences.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: Pumpkin patches, spooky trails, and scare fests are open across the UK! What's your top pick for Halloween fun this year? #Halloween

angles.name: Trick or Treat Prep
angles.copy: Getting your costume ready or stocking up on sweets? Halloween is creeping closer, with events already underway for all ages.

moments.title: Strictly's Icons Week
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns this Saturday for 'Icons Week', where celebrity contestants will embody famous faces in their routines.

angles.name: Iconic Moves
angles.copy: Who are you hoping to see celebrated on the dancefloor this Saturday for Strictly's Icons Week? Get ready for some legendary moves!

angles.name: Saturday Night Glam
angles.copy: Strictly is back this weekend with Icons Week! Expect glitter, glam, and tributes to some of the biggest names in history. What icon should they dance to?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off continues
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off continues next Tuesday at 8pm on Channel 4, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off Bites
angles.copy: Another week, another chance for a Hollywood Handshake or a soggy bottom! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday at 8pm.

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: New judge Nigella Lawson is settling into the Bake Off tent nicely! Catch the latest bakes and drama next Tuesday on Channel 4.

moments.title: Premier League weekend fixtures
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up a host of matches this weekend, including Everton vs Chelsea on Saturday and Leeds vs Manchester United on Sunday.

angles.name: Football Fever
angles.copy: Who are you backing this Premier League weekend? Big games coming up including Everton v Chelsea and Leeds v Man Utd!

angles.name: Derby Day
angles.copy: Sunday brings a classic rivalry as Leeds host Manchester United. Get ready for some intense Premier League action!

moments.title: Championship action this weekend
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship has a busy schedule, with Burnley vs Wolves tonight and Cardiff City vs Middlesbrough and Swansea City vs West Ham tomorrow.

angles.name: Championship Kicks Off
angles.copy: Tonight: Burnley vs Wolves in the Championship! Plus, local interest with Cardiff and Swansea playing tomorrow. Who are you cheering for?

angles.name: Welsh Derbies
angles.copy: Big weekend for Welsh football fans! Cardiff City face Middlesbrough tomorrow, and Swansea City host West Ham. Get behind your team!

moments.title: Happy Birthday John Mayer
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter and guitarist John Mayer turns 49 today.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to the incredible John Mayer! What's your favourite track from the guitar virtuoso?

angles.name: Mayer's Magic
angles.copy: Turning 49 today, John Mayer has given us so many hits. Let's celebrate his birthday with some of his best!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Gary Kemp
moments.blurb: Spandau Ballet's guitarist and songwriter Gary Kemp celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: True Icon
angles.copy: Gold! It's Gary Kemp's 67th Birthday today! The Spandau Ballet legend gave us some of the 80s' biggest anthems.

angles.name: 80s Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 67th Birthday to Gary Kemp of Spandau Ballet! What's your favourite Spandau track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Flea
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers bassist Flea, born Michael Peter Balzary, turns 64 today.

angles.name: Funk Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the iconic Flea from Red Hot Chili Peppers! The man brings the funk like no other.

angles.name: Chili Peppers Bassist
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of Flea, the energetic bassist of Red Hot Chili Peppers! What's your go-to RHCP song?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Karl Wallinger
moments.blurb: Welsh musician Karl Wallinger, frontman of World Party and former member of The Waterboys, turns 69 on October 19.

angles.name: Welsh Music Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 69th Birthday to Prestatyn's own Karl Wallinger on October 19! The World Party mastermind is a true Welsh music icon.

angles.name: World Party Tunes
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Karl Wallinger's birthday on Monday! What's your favourite World Party or Waterboys track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Patrick Simmons
moments.blurb: Doobie Brothers co-founder and guitarist Patrick Simmons celebrates his 78th birthday on October 19.

angles.name: Listen to the Music
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to Doobie Brothers legend Patrick Simmons on Monday! Time to put 'Listen to the Music' on repeat.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: A huge Happy Birthday to Patrick Simmons, a founding member of The Doobie Brothers, turning 78 on October 19!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bootsy Collins
moments.blurb: Funk music icon and bass legend Bootsy Collins will turn 75 on October 26.

angles.name: Funk Master
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate the one and only Bootsy Collins' 75th birthday on October 26! What's your favourite Parliament-Funkadelic track?

angles.name: Bass Legend
angles.copy: Mark your calendars for October 26 – it's Bootsy Collins' birthday! Wishing the funk legend a very happy 75th!

angles.name: Music City Festival

angles.copy: Live music alert for Exeter tonight! Catch Kris Barras Band, Elles Bailey, and DJ SNEIJDER. Where will you be?

angles.name: Friday Night Live
angles.copy: Kick off your weekend with live music in Exeter! From rock to trance, there's something for everyone tonight.
